title: Audit Log Coverage Matrix (Sensitive Actions → Expected Events)
content:
Working sheet used for weekly coverage review. This is the “single list” that the coverage scanner (ENG-2491) and CI gates reference.

Legend
- Status values used in this sheet:
  - COVERED (Green): event(s) emitted in all code paths + schema-v1 validated + integration test exists/queued.
  - PARTIAL (Yellow): emitted in some code paths OR missing required fields (actor/request_id/target) OR no integration test yet.
  - MISSING (Red): not currently emitted OR only legacy/non-schema events exist.
  - DEFERRED (Gray): explicitly out of scope for v1 GA (must have approval + tracking ticket).
- “Evidence” is the best current pointer (PR, ticket, or known log sample). Prefer PRs.
- “Notes/Gaps” should be actionable (what’s missing, who owns it, why it’s hard).

Definitions (quick)
- Sensitive action = materially impacts customer data access, security posture, billing, or availability (per program kickoff + Security Eng).
- Expected events = canonical audit schema v1 names (subject to naming guidelines / registry).

Summary (as of 2025-07-03)
- Total sensitive actions tracked in this sheet: 44
- COVERED: 27
- PARTIAL: 13
- MISSING: 3
- DEFERRED: 1

Coverage by subsystem (rough)
- Identity/RBAC/API keys: 11/14 covered, 3 partial
- Console admin + settings: 6/9 covered, 3 partial
- Model deployments/rollouts/routing: 6/8 covered, 2 partial
- Dedicated capacity + quotas: 3/5 covered, 2 partial (1 was customer-reported)
- Private installer/ops: 5/5 covered
- Audit log pipeline/export/config: 4/4 covered

Open questions / callouts
- Event naming: keep namespaces stable (api.*, console.*, rbac.*, dedicated.*, private.*, auditlog.*). See Slack:thread_1717169031.
- Actor attribution for controller-initiated actions (runtime/control plane) vs user actions: must set actor.type=service and actor.service_name. See Slack:thread_1717684410.
- Missing path identified by Support for token rotation (fixed) but keep an eye on “rotate via console” vs “rotate via API” parity. See Slack:thread_1717769021 and PR redwood/pr_18563.

Notes to self (Mei)
- When a row is PARTIAL/MISSING: add a concrete tracking ticket if it doesn’t already exist. Otherwise it never gets scheduled.
- Keep “Expected Event Name(s)” aligned with registry (PR 18437). If naming changes, update here + add alias mapping row in migration plan (ENG-2490).

Next review

- For Beta readiness: prioritize rows referenced by sales/support (SUP-4921, SUP-5033, SUP-4977).
